title: Publishing Protocols on protocols.io
author: Anita Broellochs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.si8echw
materials: A new window will open up: a

steps.title: Initiate Publication
steps.instruction: Navigate to the protocol page in view mode and click the 'PUBLISH' button.

steps.title: Define Protocol Status
steps.instruction: Select the protocol status and provide an explanation for the choice to inform other scientists.

substeps.instruction: Choose one of the following options: Working, In development, or Other.

steps.title: Confirm Approvals
steps.instruction: Check the required boxes to confirm that co-authors and supervisors agree to the publication and that you understand the protocol will be permanently available.

steps.title: Add Authors and Affiliations
steps.instruction: Add all contributing authors and their respective affiliations.

substeps.instruction: Type names separated by commas into the text field and click 'ADD', or click 'add myself as an author'.
For authors with existing protocols.io profiles, select the profile from the automatic drop-down menu.

steps.title: Categorize Protocol Type
steps.instruction: Select whether the protocol is a 'Research protocol' or a 'Non-research protocol'.

steps.title: Finalize Publication
steps.instruction: Click the 'PUBLISH' button to make the protocol publicly available on protocols.io.
